quantities_specified.name: Barrier-Normal Wind (U_perp)
quantities_specified.description: Scandes barrier-normal wind component along 290 deg WNW-ESE inflow axis
quantities_specified.causal_timestamp: MEPS 18Z D-1 forecast for valid time t0+h
quantities_specified.subterranean_handling: Not applicable (700 hPa is well above mountain top)
quantities_specified.novelty_vs_stage8_1: Provides a compact barrier-normal flow coordinate relative to 200 deg Scandes ridge; GBT tree splits cannot construct rotated projections without deep interaction terms

quantities_specified.name: Layer-Integrated Brunt-Vaisala Buoyancy Frequency (N_layer)
quantities_specified.formula: N_layer = sqrt( (g / theta_v_mean) * sum( (theta_v(p_k+1) - theta_v(p_k)) / (z(p_k+1) - z(p_k)) * (dz_k / dZ_tot) ) )
quantities_specified.description: Faithful discrete layer-integrated static atmospheric stability over Psfc to 700 hPa layer using virtual potential temperature profiles
quantities_specified.causal_timestamp: MEPS 18Z D-1 forecast for valid time t0+h
quantities_specified.subterranean_handling: Subterranean pressure levels (p > Psfc) strictly excluded. Layer bottom set to valid surface state (Psfc, T2m, q2m)
quantities_specified.novelty_vs_stage8_1: Stage 8.1 lacks vertical potential temperature profile gradients and buoyancy frequency integrals

quantities_specified.name: Mountain Froude Number (Fr)

quantities_specified.causal_timestamp: MEPS 18Z D-1 forecast for valid time t0+h
quantities_specified.novelty_vs_stage8_1: Unites wind vector, static atmospheric stability, and mountain geometry into a non-linear non-dimensional flow regime index

w_oro_analysis.rationale: w_oro = U_perp * |grad z| is 100% linearly collinear with U_perp for a single-station static target site (Nuolja). Terrain slope along inflow axis is a constant multiplier (C_slope ~ 0.1507 m/m). Excluded to prevent feature redundancy and adhere to minimal feature set design
